content:
A plain, brown, beer bottle containing a Carry Weight boosting liquid. When consumed, it gives a 30 min boost to Carry Weight and quenches a small amount of thirst with no risk of addiction, no rads, and no hangover effect.

During the earliest iteration of the scoreboard during the private test server, this item was called "Rad Ant Wee Heavy." It was later changed to "Rad Ant Weight Lager" in the final PTS update. Its final name did not appear until the public release of Locked & Loaded.

Previously only available as a reward during Season 4, it was made available for purchase in the Steel Reign update.
